decisions.reason: The MT3608 enable pull-down establishes the default state of the switched 5V rail but does not change the ESP32 clock, sleep policy, deep-sleep conditions, or wake sources.
Adding a pull-down to the boost converter enable pin does not change the battery connector's required NTC contact.
The switched-rail default-off behavior does not alter the specified battery overcharge, overdischarge, or thermal protection requirements.
The MT3608 enable pull-down is unrelated to the I2C bus pull-ups, cable-length limit, and bus speed.
